{{Quote|I met my old master. He&hellip; he cried when he saw me. I was embarrassed to see his weakness. Old habits die hard. But&hellip; it felt good, too. It felt good to know he missed me, that he worried about me.|Yuthura Ban|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
This '''male''' was the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of [[Yuthura Ban]].

==History==
Yuthura was discovered by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] on a desolate world, having been abandoned there by the crew of a cargo ship she had stowed away on to escape from [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]], and her life as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]. Recognizing her [[The Force/Legends|Force]] potential the master took Yuthura to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], to be trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], taking the young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. The partnership would not last long, however, as Yuthura, consumed with hatred towards the slave trade, and infruiated by the Jedi's apathy toward it, left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]], eventually joining the new [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]]. Yuthura returned to the Jedi after being redeemed by a reformed Revan and upon seeing his old apprentice, the Jedi wept.<ref name="KotOR" />
